finding: Apache Solr 8.11.0: Log4Shell RCE, ConfigSet privilege escalation, unauthenticated admin access
status: Remediated (RCE) - verified by scan 2026-10-16; authentication pending
remediation: Replaced vulhub Solr 8.11.0 with official solr:9 image; enable authentication (security.json)
rationale: DMZ-exposed unauthenticated RCE on CISA KEV with public exploits. Solr findings absent from 2026-10-16 authenticated scan. SLA breached (remediated 3 days late). Residual: confirm whether unauthenticated admin access finding persists.

Confirmed in authenticated scan 2026-10-16. KEV CVE-2017-12617 requires HTTP PUT; verified 2026-10-18 that readonly is not overridden in web.xml (default true), so PUT is rejected and the KEV item is not exploitable. Remaining driver: end-of-life branch with version-based Critical (CVSS 9.8, EPSS 0.22). Accepted for 30 days with compensating controls; upgrade to supported branch required before expiry.

remediation: Replaced vulhub httpd 2.4.49 build with official httpd:2.4 image
rationale: Nessus reported version only (Info); banner check suppressed by 'avoid potential false alarms'. Exploitation confirmed manually 2026-10-16 (unauthenticated request returned container /etc/passwd). Fix verified 2026-10-18: path-traversal request returns 400 Bad Request; server reports Apache/2.4.69. SLA breached.

finding: Java debug port (JDWP) exposed on Solr container
remediation: Solr image replaced; port 5005 no longer published
rationale: Not flagged by Nessus (service reported as unknown). JDWP is unauthenticated and allows remote code execution; public tooling exists. Fix verified 2026-10-18: connection to 5005 refused. SLA breached.

finding: Ubuntu 24.04 OS packages missing security updates
remediation: Applied pending Ubuntu updates during change window; long term rebuild as minimal server image
rationale: No Ubuntu Critical/High findings in 2026-10-16 authenticated scan. Highest-EPSS items had been verified not reachable (telnetd not installed; Net-SNMP and Samba daemons absent). Root cause remains: desktop OS on a DMZ server.

finding: Apache Log4j 1.2.9 in dormant repository files
remediation: Deleted unused vulhub repository copies (nested clone and struts2 folder)
rationale: Files on disk only (S2-009.war in vulhub repo); not loaded by any running service and not network-reachable. VPR drivers: exploit maturity unproven, no recorded threat activity.

finding: Router hardening: SSH password auth, SHA-1 MACs, unnecessary packages, ICMP timestamp
remediation: Key-only SSH, root login disabled, SHA-1 MACs removed (sshd_config.d/99-hardening.conf); GNOME desktop task, apache2-bin and libapache2-mod-dnssd purged; ICMP limited to echo-request, destination-unreachable, time-exceeded
rationale: No exploitable vulnerabilities found. Tier-0 asset, so configuration weaknesses and unnecessary software are addressed to reduce attack surface. Password login refusal confirmed 2026-10-18 (Permission denied (publickey)); scan account key login retained. Root cause: Debian install included the GNOME desktop task.

remediation: TraceEnable Off applied via docker-compose command on httpd:2.4 container (persists across recreation)
rationale: Introduced by the replacement httpd:2.4 image (TRACE enabled by default): example of remediation introducing a new finding. Manual check: TRACE request should return 405.

finding: Tomcat manager and default apps exposed over HTTP (cleartext / Basic auth, default files)
remediation: Removed vulhub bind-mounted manager config; compose command deletes manager, host-manager, examples and docs at every container start
rationale: Manager login was exposed over cleartext HTTP from the DMZ. Default-credential test inconclusive (manager returned 404 before removal). First in-container removal failed on bind-mounted context.xml; remediation moved into docker-compose so it persists across recreation. Verified 2026-10-18: webapps contains ROOT only.
